name: Hatano Tooru
source:
His hobby is to expose his girlfriend to the world, and he loves to see her embarrassed and frightened face.

He is slender, and good-looking in all ways, and is loved by everyone around him as a nice young man. He is Rina's childhood friend and first love.

The sincere Rina decides to devote herself to Tooru in order to satisfy his sexual desires.

[From [url=http://www.soft-parthenon.com/product/ros/index.html#character]official site[/url]]
